catalogLoadErrorDesc: Check your connection and try again.
heroSubtitle: All machine vision knowledge, in one place.
provenanceNote: Compiled from public sources: vendor websites, press releases, product catalogs and datasheets. Each value shows its current source and the date it was retrieved; a value the vendor does not publish shows as not published.
principleNotPublishedDesc: A value the vendor does not publish shows "Not published", never a guess.
principleProvenanceDesc: Each value shows its current source: the source type, the date it was retrieved and a link when there is one.
principleIndependentDesc: Compiled from public sources, with every source cited. Inclusion and ranking are never for sale.
aboutDescription: A catalog of machine vision products and their vendors, compiled from public sources, in {count} domains: {domains}.
aboutPageDescription: What the catalog holds and where its data comes from.
notFoundPage: The requested page could not be found.
catalogDescription: Browse machine vision products by category, pipeline stage and specification.
askDescription: Ask a question about machine vision products, or describe an inspection problem, in plain words; the answer cites the products it rests on.
askSubtitle: Ask in plain words; every answer cites its sources.
askExample1: Which camera reads barcodes on boxes?
askExample2: Which line scan cameras have a CoaXPress interface?
askExample3: Which thermal cameras work in the long-wave infrared?
askRefused: The catalog holds no answer to this question.
askNeedUnmet: No product in the catalog meets this need.
askNote: Written by a language model from the cited products. Check the sources.
sourcesDescription: The current source of each value on this page.
noSourcesAvailable: No source is recorded for this product.
noVendorProducts: No products are listed for this vendor.
reportErrorAction: Report an error on this product
historyIntro: Every recorded version: when, who, why, what changed and its sources.
historyEmpty: No earlier version of this record is kept.
compareDescription: Compare the specifications of up to 3 machine vision products side by side.
compareSubtitle: Specifications of up to 3 products, side by side.
compareEmptyTitle: Pick up to 3 products in the catalog to compare them.
authNotConfiguredHint: This build has no Firebase web config, so sign-in is off.
authSignInPrompt: Sign in with the founder's account.
authNotAuthorized: This account does not carry the admin role.
reportHint: Name the value and what the source says. The report goes to the review queue; nothing changes until it is checked.
reportFiled: Report received. It waits in the review queue.
reportCounted: This report was already in the queue: it now counts once more.
reportFailed: The report was not sent. Try again later.
reportProtection: This form is protected by {name}; {owner}'s [Privacy Policy] and [Terms of Service] apply.
newsDescription: What changed in the catalog: products, vendors, versions and lifecycle notices, each sentence with what it rests on.
newsAiDrafted: Drafted with AI from the catalog record; reviewed by the editors on {date}
agentsDescription: Query the cited catalog from an MCP client: search products and sources, read a product, propose a correction.
agentsPageDescription: Connect an AI agent to Machine Vision Radar over MCP: the endpoint, the token and the setup for Claude Code and Cursor.
agentsAuthDesc: Every request carries a bearer token in the Authorization header. The site's editors issue tokens with a read or a propose scope.
marketDescription: The machine-vision market as the catalog counts it: each number states how many records it rests on.
marketCountriesBase: {located} of the {organizations} organizations state their country.
marketOwnershipBase: Acquisitions, mergers and brands, newest first; the undated last.
marketVendorsBase: Organizations with a listed product: {vendors} of {organizations}.
